sources.supportingExcerpt: Tourist Visa is processed by visa agents or hotels in the UAE. Ensure you receive a copy before traveling.

policies.title: Taiwan ordinary passports: UAE advance tourist visa
policies.summary: The UAE Embassy's current Taiwan record marks Regular passports Visa Required; its non-exempt visitor instructions require obtaining the tourist-visa copy before travel.
conditions: Applies only to the UAE Embassy's Taiwan Regular-passport category and an ordinary short tourist visit.
A visa on arrival is restricted to exempt nationalities with the appropriate passport type; Taiwan Regular is marked Visa Required.
For a tourist visit, the Embassy says UAE visa agents or hotels process the visa and that the traveller must receive a copy before travel.
This does not establish an eVisa, airline transit visa, GCC-resident route, work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or final-admission rule.

conflicts.explanation: The UAE Embassy's live Taiwan record marks a Regular passport Visa Required. Its non-exempt visitor instructions require a tourist-visa copy before travelling, so the electronic-visa fallback is not the supported baseline.
